result.topic_en: A page of Gauss's mathematical diary from early 1797 recording entries on the lemniscate integral, Euler's criterion, the complete integral of dx/sqrt(1-x^n), polygon construction, the form aa+bb+cc-bc-ac-ab, and a continued-fraction expansion of a series.
result.transcription:
Curuam [-elasticam-] {+lemniscatam+} a $\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-x^4)}}$) pendentem
perscrutari coepi Jan. 8
Criterii Euleriani rationem sponte detexi Jan. 10.
Integrale complet. $\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt[n]{(1-x^n)}}$ ad circ. quadr. reducere
commentus sum. Jan. 12.
Methodus facilis $\int\frac{x^{n-1}dx}{1+x^m}$ determinandi
Supplementum eximium ad polygonorum descriptionem inueni. sc. si a, b, c, d sint factores primi
numeri primi p unitate truncati tunc ad polygoni p laterum
nihil aliud requiri quam ut 1° arcus indefinitus in a, b, c
d.. partes secetur 2° ut polygona a, b, c, d.. laterum
describantur. Gotting. Januar. 19
Theoremata de Ress. $-1\mp 2$ simili methodo [-pertro-] [?] demonstratae et cetera . . . . Gott. Febr. 4.
Forma $aa+bb+cc-bc-ac-ab$ quod ad diuisores
attinet conuenit cum hac $aa+3bb$ Febr. 6
Amplificatio prop. penult. p. 1. scilicet
$1-a+a^3-a^6+a^{10}\ldots = \cfrac{1}{1+\cfrac{a}{1+\cfrac{a^2-a}{1+\cfrac{a^3}{1+\cfrac{a^4-a^2}{1+\cfrac{a^5}{1+\&c.}}}}}}$ Febr. 16
Unde facile omnes series
ubi exp. ser. sec.
ordinis constituunt
transformantur

methods.what: Study of the lemniscate curve via the integral of dx/sqrt(1-x^4)
Proof/reason for Euler's criterion for quadratic residues
Reduction of the complete integral of dx/(1-x^n)^{1/n} to quadrature of the circle
methods.quote:
Integrale complet. $\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt[n]{(1-x^n)}}$ ad circ. quadr. reducere
commentus sum.

methods.what: Easy method to evaluate the integral of x^{n-1}/(1+x^m)
Constructing a regular p-gon reduces to dividing arcs into a,b,c,... parts and constructing a-,b-,c-gons, where a,b,c,... are prime factors of p-1
methods.quote:
si a, b, c, d sint factores primi
numeri primi p unitate truncati tunc ad polygoni p laterum
nihil aliud requiri quam ut 1° arcus indefinitus in a, b, c
d.. partes secetur 2° ut polygona a, b, c, d.. laterum
describantur.

methods.what: Theorems on quadratic residues -1 and ±2 proved by a similar method
methods.quote: Theoremata de Ress. $-1\mp 2$ simili methodo [-pertro-] [?] demonstratae

methods.what: The form a^2+b^2+c^2-bc-ac-ab has the same divisors as a^2+3b^2
methods.quote:
Forma $aa+bb+cc-bc-ac-ab$ quod ad diuisores
attinet conuenit cum hac $aa+3bb$

methods.what: Continued fraction expansion of the series 1-a+a^3-a^6+a^10-... (triangular-number exponents)
General transformation of series whose exponents form a second-order arithmetic series
methods.quote:
Unde facile omnes series
ubi exp. ser. sec.
ordinis constituunt
transformantur

items.english: The form aa+bb+cc-bc-ac-ab agrees, as regards its divisors, with the form aa+3bb.
